theme: A quiet St Pete Sunday under a loud Croatia countdown.
greeting: The girls are home in St Pete and the calendar's nearly empty, Dan. The real story is the trip clock: Croatia leaves in nine days, and the bookings that can only be done from dry land are still open.

needsAttention.title: Confirm Croatia checked bags in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued Eurowings Discover ticket shows 0 checked bags. Confirm the allowance on the operating carrier's own site and screenshot it before Sept 8 — European counter fees run well above pre-purchase. Overdue since Aug 25 on the Board.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 19 Cavtat night and transfer
needsAttention.detail: The last night before the DBV flight, airport-side in Cavtat, plus the Komolac transfer. Two Board tasks cover the same booking; it has to be locked from land before you sail Sept 8. Overdue since Aug 26.

needsAttention.title: Fill the Sept 20–22 St Pete landing gap
needsAttention.detail: Two nights in St Pete after the Croatia flight and before the Tue kid pickup and Orlando villa. Still open on the Board, overdue since Aug 25.

needsAttention.title: Nautilus charter balance is due
needsAttention.detail: QuickBooks flags invoice #2170 for the sailing charter as unfinished, with a balance still owed. Worth clearing before departure — it landed in your inbox Aug 29.

flagged.title: Nautilus charter invoice unpaid
flagged.detail: QuickBooks says invoice #2170 for the charter isn't finished — balance still due before the trip.

flagged.title: Care.com applicants stacking up
flagged.detail: Four caregivers applied and a message is waiting on the job you posted — worth one review pass.

inbox.noise: The rest is promos and digests — Chairish, a Dex weekly, a triple-monitor pitch, a Substack receipt.

recipe.title: Canal house year-round caprese salad
recipe.why: High summer means tomatoes and basil at their peak, so this one asks almost nothing of you.

tasks.title: Book the Sept 20–Oct 5 backup rental car (refundable)
Buy EU plug adapters + a US power strip

acts.line: The 15-minute Sunday review with Mike is done, so the Board's set for the week ahead.
An open stretch — the best window all week to close the Croatia bookings that can't wait for the boat.
Nothing on the calendar; a normal night at home with the four girls.
